title: Clear denominators for a local map from a closed structure module
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $i:W\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $W$ integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and let $G$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $\eta$ be the generic point of $W$, and let $U\subseteq X$ be open with $i(\eta)\in U$. For any morphism $\varphi:(i_*\mathcal O_W)|_U\to G|_U$ [def-pc-module-pullback, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], there are a nonzero quasi-coherent ideal $J\subseteq\mathcal O_W$ and a morphism $\alpha:i_*J\to G$ such that $\alpha|_U=(i_*(J\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_W))|_U$ followed by $\varphi$. No injectivity hypothesis or monomorphism conclusion is imposed.

source.place: Tag 01YB (lemma-homs-over-open), and the last paragraph of Tag 01YE; affine closed-pushforward comparison from Tag 01QY.

proof.text: Let I be the reduced ideal of X minus U. Its restriction to U is the unit ideal. The closed structure pushforward H is coherent by qcqs pushforward, cyclic affine sections of the closed quotient, the affine finite-type criterion, and the locally Noetherian coherence criterion.
Apply Tag 01YB to H and G. It gives n >= 0 and chi:I^n H -> G whose restriction, after the product inclusion, agrees with phi on U. G is quasi-coherent by coherence and the Noetherian hypothesis.

On an affine Spec A of X with W given by A/K and I by L, the sections of I^n H are L^n (A/K). They are the image ideal of L^n in A/K, commute with localization, and thus glue to an ideal J on W. Equivalently J = (I O_W)^n, taking J = O_W at n = 0. The affine ideal-power image comparison identifies i_*J with I^n H and commutes with the inclusions into H. Compose this isomorphism with chi to get alpha; restricting the inclusion identity to U gives the asserted equality.

Since i(eta) lies in U, I has unit stalk there, so J has full generic stalk. On an integral scheme the generic local ring is a nonzero field, and the integral ideal generic-stalk criterion gives J != 0. This also covers n = 0 and the zero local map: nonzeroness concerns J, not alpha.

proof_origin.place: Ideal-power extension adapted to the ambient closed structure pushforward; affine quotient calculation identifies the source ideal.

theorem local_closed_ideal_map_extension
    {X W : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (i : W ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral W]
    (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (U : X.Opens) (hx : i.base (genericPoint W) ∈ U)
    (φ : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        ((pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)) ⟶
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G) :
    ∃ (J : W.IdealSheafData), J ≠ ⊥ ∧
      ∃ (α : (pushforward i).obj J.toModules ⟶ G),
        (restrictFunctor U.ι).map α =
          (restrictFunctor U.ι).map ((pushforward i).map J.toModulesι) ≫ φ
